info.title: Kamichu!
info.synopsis: Yurie Hitotsubashi è una studentessa che vive nella città di Onomichi. La ragazza passa le sue giornate a preoccuparsi degli esami e cercando di farsi notare da Kenji, il ragazzo che le piace. La sua routine quotidiana cambia quando un giorno annuncia alla sua amica Mitsue che durante la notte è diventata una dea. La loro compagna di classe Matsuri, venuta a sapere della cosa, cerca di convincere Yurie a sostituire il loro sfortunato dio locale, Yashima-sama, per rendere il santuario della sua famiglia più popolare e salvarlo dalla bancarotta. Così, con Matsuri come manager, Yurie deve esaudire desideri, curare maledizioni, incontrare gli alieni e partecipare alle convenzioni di Dio; il tutto continuando a frequentare la scuola e cercando di trovare per il coraggio di confessare a Kenji i propri sentimenti.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: When Yurie announces during lunch that last night she became a god, Matsuri, as the daughter of a Shinto priest, tries to help her figure out what kind of god she is. During their efforts, Yurie accidentally creates a typhoon, which she has to dispel to save Kenji.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Matsuri decides her family's shrine will host a festival in honor of Yurie, but discovers Yashima, the god of the shrine, has gone missing. Yurie travels to the land of the gods to convince him to return.

episodes.synopsis: Yurie catches a cold and stays at home for a few days, but her friends don't come to visit. Feeling lonely, she uses her powers to depart from her body as a spirit and visit them instead.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: On their summer vacation, Yurie and her friends go to a quiet part of the seashore and explore an abandoned beach house. The gods living there want to know what's become of the people who once enjoyed themselves there, and Yurie fulfills their wish.

episodes.synopsis: Yurie and her friends meet an old man named Gen who was once a crewman of the battleship Yamato. Shortly afterwards, she receives a message from the sunken battleship, which wants to visit its home port again.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: When Yurie resolves to give Kenji chocolate for Valentine's Day and confess her love, the entire school and everyone in town pitches in to help her. After a brief awkward conversation upon the school's roof, the two are lifted into the sky upon a large piece of paper (upon which, Kenji had written the kanji character for 'love'). As they soar above the town, Kenji tells Yurie that he loves her, because she is strange. The character on the flying paper turns into the kanji for 'strange'.
